# Reader fixtures

Captured on 8 October 2026 from the local CyberJudah Worker backed by its public data feed. These are Genesis 1 KJV text, coverage, concordance spans and a Hebrew lexicon batch. They contain no account or production-user data. Resource revision/hash fields are preserved. Tests serve these responses without network access.

The KJV text and original Strong dictionaries are public domain. The Hebrew lexicon transcription remains a separate share-alike fixture under **CC-BY-SA-unversioned**, matching `docs/resources.md`; no licence version is inferred. Modification: selected the existing CyberJudah HTTP responses needed to exercise the reader, without changing their text.

Upstream source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openscriptures/strongs/0acd2f251c2d35ff8db2dece4e0593979d3ac223/hebrew/strongs-hebrew-dictionary.js

SHA-256: `5ce6aeed551c709f49bcfa341cadf2f34bc7599b85d9de9e6ac2ecbf60fc3739`
